radiance.name: Radiance
radiance.blurb: Celestial light and purity. Sunlight spreads from your structures: your soldiers heal and strike harder in it, blight withers, and nothing hides. Heal, smite, and let the Phoenix rise again.
tips: Sunbearers carry Sunstone from nodes to the Citadel or a Sunstone Vault.
Sunlight spreads from your structures. Your units heal in it, blight burns away, and hidden enemies are revealed.
Radiant Shrines heal nearby units and generate Dawnlight for your elite and your spells.
Phoenix Heralds rise again once after death. A Phoenix Feather summons the Avatar of Dawn.

tiers.name: Sunforge Citadel — Solar Crown
tiers.desc: Unlocks Tier 2 structures and a second hero. Sunlight spreads farther.

tiers.name: Sunforge Citadel — Zenith
tiers.desc: Unlocks Tier 3 units and the third hero. The Zenith crown pours permanent beams of light.

sunbearer.name: Sunbearer
sunbearer.desc: Worker. Gathers Sunstone and builds structures.

solar_archer.name: Solar Archer
solar_archer.desc: Ranged. Arrows of focused light strike ground and air.

sun_priest.name: Sun Priest
sun_priest.desc: Healer. Mends wounded allies with sunlight (auto). Weak attack.

sunforged_knight.name: Sunforged Knight
sunforged_knight.desc: Heavy cavalry in blazing plate. Fast, armored charge.

phoenix_herald.name: Phoenix Herald
phoenix_herald.desc: Flying firebird. Splash fire on ground and air. Rises again once after death.

pyrestorm_engine.name: Pyrestorm Engine
pyrestorm_engine.desc: Siege engine hurling solar fire. Splash, double vs structures.

radiant_angel.name: Radiant Angel
radiant_angel.desc: Celestial flier. Smites with holy light and mends allies between strikes.

solar_titan.name: Solar Titan
solar_titan.desc: Colossal sun-forged construct. Splash melee, carries sunlight with it.

avatar_of_dawn.name: Avatar of Dawn
avatar_of_dawn.desc: One may exist. The sun made flesh: burns enemies and heals allies around it.

aurelian.name: Aurelian Dawnblade
aurelian.title: Sunforged Champion
aurelian.desc: Frontline paladin. Smites, rallies and calls down the judgment of the sun.

seraphine.name: Seraphine Lightkeeper
seraphine.title: Dawn Oracle
seraphine.desc: Healer and steward. Blesses the tithe, sanctifies ground, and raises the fallen.

solaris.name: Solaris
solaris.title: the Archon
solaris.desc: Ranged sun-mage. Lances of light, dawn bursts, light-steps and the Supernova.

sunforge_citadel.name: Sunforge Citadel
sunforge_citadel.desc: Your main base. Trains Sunbearers and heroes, receives Sunstone, radiates sunlight.

solar_crucible.name: Solar Crucible
solar_crucible.desc: Unit and weapon production. Trains Legionaries and Solar Archers; at Tier 2 forges Sunforged Knights and Pyrestorm Engines. Researches Blessed Steel and Sunforged Plate. +8 supply.

sunstone_vault.name: Sunstone Vault
sunstone_vault.desc: Built on a Sunstone node. Drop-off for Sunbearers; refines a trickle (0.5/s) on its own. +4 supply.

radiant_shrine.name: Radiant Shrine
radiant_shrine.desc: Trains Sun Priests, heals nearby units (3/s) and generates Dawnlight (0.8/s). Spreads sunlight. Required for Tier 2.

blazing_bastion.name: Blazing Bastion
blazing_bastion.desc: Defensive tower. Beams of concentrated sunlight; +25% damage when standing in sunlight.

emberline_gate.name: Emberline Gate
emberline_gate.desc: Wall segment of sun-tempered stone. Burns melee attackers.

dawnwatch_beacon.name: Dawnwatch Beacon
dawnwatch_beacon.desc: Sensor tower with long sight. Reveals hidden units and spreads sunlight.

heliarch_spire.name: Heliarch Spire
heliarch_spire.desc: Technology centre. Researches Daybreak, Radiant Wards and Eternal Dawn; trickles Dawnlight (0.8/s). Required for Tier 3. At Tier 3 forges Solar Titans and, with a Phoenix Feather, the Avatar of Dawn. Channels a Feather every 150s.

phoenix_roost.name: Phoenix Roost
phoenix_roost.desc: (addition to the canon list) Roost of solar fire for Phoenix Heralds and, at Tier 3, Radiant Angels. +6 supply.

pyrestorm_battery.name: Pyrestorm Battery
pyrestorm_battery.desc: Long-range artillery structure. Slow, heavy solar shells with splash.

solar_relay.name: Solar Relay
solar_relay.desc: Map-wide power projection. Solar Surge: for 15s all Radiance units gain +20% damage and towers +50%.

daybreak.name: Daybreak
daybreak.desc: Sunlight spreads 50% faster; units in sunlight regenerate +1.5 hp/s more.

phoenix_fire.name: Phoenix Fire
phoenix_fire.desc: Healing from priests, angels and shrines is 40% stronger.

eternal_dawn.name: Eternal Dawn
eternal_dawn.desc: Units standing in sunlight gain 12% lifesteal.

sanctuary.name: Sanctuary
sanctuary.blurb: Divine order and celestial protection. Every soldier carries a holy ward that absorbs damage and recharges. Consecrated ground shields the faithful and banishes corruption; the Eternal Bell rallies the whole host.
tips: Pilgrims carry Sacred Crystals from nodes to the Citadel or a Sanctified Vault.
Your units have wards: a blue shield bar that soaks damage and recharges after 5s out of combat.
Holy ground spreads from your structures: allies take less damage on it, undead deal less, and hidden foes are revealed.
The Eternal Bell Spire rallies your army. A Seraph's Tear calls down the Archangel.

tiers.name: Luminarch Citadel — Cathedral
tiers.desc: Unlocks Tier 2 structures and a second hero. Holy ground spreads farther.

tiers.name: Luminarch Citadel — Celestial Sanctum
tiers.desc: Unlocks Tier 3 units and the third hero. The Citadel gathers Seraph's Tears.

pilgrim.name: Pilgrim
pilgrim.desc: Worker. Gathers Sacred Crystals and builds structures.

temple_guard.name: Temple Guard
temple_guard.desc: Warded shield infantry. Steady and hard to break.

seraphic_archer.name: Seraphic Archer
seraphic_archer.desc: Ranged. Blessed arrows strike ground and air.

cleric.name: Cleric
cleric.desc: Healer. Mends allies with Holy Light (auto). Weak attack, strong vs undead.

celestial_paladin.name: Celestial Paladin
celestial_paladin.desc: Heavily warded holy knight. The wall of the faithful.

divine_griffin.name: Divine Griffin
divine_griffin.desc: Flying beast of heaven. Dives on ground and air targets.

inquisitor.name: Inquisitor
inquisitor.desc: Holy caster. Searing light, double damage to the undead.

blessed_trebuchet.name: Blessed Trebuchet
blessed_trebuchet.desc: Consecrated siege engine. Splash, double vs structures.

seraph.name: Seraph
seraph.desc: Winged celestial. Smites with light and heals allies between strikes.

exemplar.name: Exemplar
exemplar.desc: Champion of the Concord. Immense ward, splash strikes, carries holy ground.

archangel.name: Archangel
archangel.desc: One may exist. Heaven's general: an aura that shields allies and burns the unholy.

isolde.name: Commander Isolde Vale
isolde.title: Shield of the Concord
isolde.desc: Frontline commander. Holy strikes, shield walls, banners of order and divine intervention.

adaline.name: Mother Adaline
adaline.title: Voice of the Bell
adaline.desc: Healer and steward. Mends wounds, consecrates ground, blesses the tithe and raises the fallen.

cassiel.name: Oracle Cassiel
cassiel.title: Eye of Heaven
cassiel.desc: Ranged oracle. Smites, banishes corruption, steps through light and calls the wrath of heaven.

luminarch_citadel.name: Luminarch Citadel
luminarch_citadel.desc: Your main base. Trains Pilgrims and heroes, receives crystals, consecrates the ground.

beaconwright_hall.name: Beaconwright Hall
beaconwright_hall.desc: Unit production. Trains Temple Guards and Seraphic Archers. Researches Blessed Arms. +8 supply.

sanctified_vault.name: Sanctified Vault
sanctified_vault.desc: Built on a crystal node. Drop-off for Pilgrims; refines a trickle (0.5/s). +4 supply.

sacrosanct_shrine.name: Sacrosanct Shrine
sacrosanct_shrine.desc: Healing and blessing. Trains Clerics, heals nearby (3/s), generates Holy Light (0.8/s). Consecrates ground. Required for Tier 2.

radiant_tower.name: Radiant Tower
radiant_tower.desc: Defensive tower. Beams of holy light against ground and air; +25% on holy ground.

refuge_gatehouse.name: Refuge Gatehouse
refuge_gatehouse.desc: Wall segment of white marble. Consecrates the ground beside it.

lightborne_relay.name: Lightborne Relay
lightborne_relay.desc: Map-wide illumination. Long sight, reveals hidden units, spreads holy ground.

concord_hall.name: Concord Hall
concord_hall.desc: Technology centre. Researches Greater Wards and Divine Favor; trickles Holy Light (0.8/s). Required for Tier 3.

hall_of_luminaries.name: Hall of Luminaries
hall_of_luminaries.desc: Hero and champion command. Trains Celestial Paladins and Inquisitors; at Tier 3 Exemplars. +6 supply.

griffin_aerie.name: Griffin Aerie
griffin_aerie.desc: (invented) Eyrie of Divine Griffins; at Tier 3 Seraphs. +6 supply.

eternal_bell_spire.name: Eternal Bell Spire
eternal_bell_spire.desc: Global rally. Toll the Bell: for 15s every Sanctuary unit gains +20% damage and +15% speed. Nearby allies attack faster.

altar_of_tears.name: Altar of Tears
altar_of_tears.desc: (invented) Gathers a Seraph's Tear every 150s (holds 1). Calls the Archangel. Researches Martyrdom.

divine_favor.name: Divine Favor
divine_favor.desc: Healing from clerics, seraphs and shrines is 40% stronger.

martyrdom.name: Martyrdom
martyrdom.desc: Units on holy ground gain 12% lifesteal and +1 hp/s.

verdance.name: Verdance
verdance.blurb: Living architecture and the balance of the wild. Your structures grow on their own, the grove spreads beneath your feet to slow foes and mend allies, and Sylvan Waystones let your host step across the map.
tips: Tenders carry Silver Sap from nodes to the Spire. Buildings keep growing even after Tenders walk away.
The grove spreads from your structures: allies heal and move faster on it, enemies are slowed by vines.
Two Sylvan Waystones link into a teleport network. Cycle Sanctuaries heal everything nearby.
Spirits of the Everwood and beasts of the Wild Den are your strike force. A World Seed wakes the Heart of the Everwood.

tiers.name: Everwood Spire — Silver Bloom
tiers.desc: Branches grow out and silver sap flows. Unlocks Tier 2 structures and a second hero.

tiers.name: Everwood Spire — Luminous Canopy
tiers.desc: The canopy blossoms. Unlocks Tier 3 units and the third hero; the Spire cradles World Seeds.

tender.name: Tender
tender.desc: Worker. Gathers Silver Sap and plants structures.

briar_archer.name: Briar Archer
briar_archer.desc: Ranged. Thorn-tipped arrows strike ground and air.

forest_nymph.name: Forest Nymph
forest_nymph.desc: Healer spirit. Mends allies with living sap (auto).

verdant_sentinel.name: Verdant Sentinel
verdant_sentinel.desc: Soulborn guardian of living wood. Tanky, regenerates on the grove.

everwood_spirit.name: Spirit of the Everwood
everwood_spirit.desc: Flying nature spirit. Fast, ethereal, strikes ground and air.

dire_stag.name: Dire Stag
dire_stag.desc: Light cavalry of the wild. Fast antlered charge.

rootcrusher.name: Rootcrusher
rootcrusher.desc: Siege beast hurling seed-bombs. Splash, double vs structures.

ancient_treant.name: Ancient Treant
ancient_treant.desc: Walking elder tree. Splash melee, spreads the grove as it walks.

great_owl.name: Great Owl
great_owl.desc: Silent flying hunter with enormous sight. Strikes ground and air.

heart_of_the_everwood.name: Heart of the Everwood
heart_of_the_everwood.desc: One may exist. The forest itself risen to war; heals allies and roots enemies around it.

kael.name: Kael Thornwarden
kael.title: Warden of the Briar
kael.desc: Frontline warden. Briar charges, bark skin, thorn bursts and the wrath of the wild.

elowen.name: Elowen
elowen.title: the Grovekeeper
elowen.desc: Keeper of the grove. Mends, seeds the land, blesses the harvest and calls the bloom of life.

sylvara.name: Sylvara
sylvara.title: Spiritcaller
sylvara.desc: Spirit mage. Spirit bolts, entangling vines, spirit-walks and awakens the Everwood.

everwood_spire.name: Everwood Spire
everwood_spire.desc: Your main base: a titanic living tree. Trains Tenders and heroes, receives sap, spreads the grove.

bloomforge.name: Bloomforge
bloomforge.desc: Flowering armoury. Trains Thornguards and Briar Archers; at Tier 2 Dire Stags. Forges Sharpened Thorns. +8 supply.

groveheart_nexus.name: Groveheart Nexus
groveheart_nexus.desc: Built on a sap node. Refines Silver Sap (0.5/s), drop-off for Tenders. Spreads the grove. +4 supply.

verdant_sigil_hall.name: Verdant Sigil Hall
verdant_sigil_hall.desc: Soulborn training centre. Trains Forest Nymphs; at Tier 2 Verdant Sentinels. Generates Everwood Essence (0.8/s). Required for Tier 2.

rootwarden_bastion.name: Rootwarden Bastion
rootwarden_bastion.desc: Defensive tower of living roots. Thorn volleys against ground and air; +25% on the grove.

thornwall_gatehouse.name: Thornwall Gatehouse
thornwall_gatehouse.desc: Living wall of thornroots. Entangles and lacerates enemies that press against it.

cycle_sanctuary.name: Cycle Sanctuary
cycle_sanctuary.desc: Sacred sap spring. Heals nearby units (4/s) and regenerates Everwood Essence (0.8/s). Required for Tier 3.

sylvan_waystone.name: Sylvan Waystone
sylvan_waystone.desc: Teleportation monolith. Waystep: send allies within 3 tiles to another of your Waystones. Grants vision.

wild_den.name: Wild Den
wild_den.desc: (invented) Beast lair. Trains Rootcrushers; at Tier 3 Great Owls. +6 supply.

spirit_tree.name: Spirit Tree
spirit_tree.desc: (invented) Trains Spirits of the Everwood; at Tier 3 Ancient Treants. +6 supply.

sapwood_granary.name: Sapwood Granary
sapwood_granary.desc: Resource storage. +12 supply and a small sap trickle (0.3/s).

everglen_outpost.name: Everglen Outpost
everglen_outpost.desc: Forward base. Drop-off for sap, wide vision, spreads the grove far from home.

world_seed_altar.name: World Seed Altar
world_seed_altar.desc: (invented) Cradles a World Seed every 150s (holds 1). Wakes the Heart of the Everwood.

symbiosis.name: Symbiosis
symbiosis.desc: Units on the grove gain 15% lifesteal and +1 hp/s.

everwood_blessing.name: Everwood's Blessing
everwood_blessing.desc: Healing from nymphs and sanctuaries is 40% stronger; all units +1 hp/s.

abyss.name: Abyss
abyss.blurb: Slow-building attrition powerhouse. Every death near your forces yields Soul Essence. Spread blight to claim the ground, raise the dead, and sacrifice the weak to empower the strong. Survive the early game and become inevitable.
tips: Souls flow from every death near your units — trade fodder freely.
Acolytes carry souls from fonts to the Necropolis. A Soul Well on a font channels souls on its own.
Blight spreads from your Necropolis; your undead heal on it and enemies weaken.
Necromancers raise skeletons from corpses. Malazar's Curse turns enemy dead into your army.

tiers.name: Profane Citadel
tiers.desc: Unlocks Tier 2 structures, a second hero and stronger blight. +25% soul harvest from kills.

tiers.name: Oblivion Spire
tiers.desc: Unlocks Tier 3 units and the third hero. Shadow of the Void: enemies on blight lose 15% damage. Produces Oblivion Shards.

acolyte.name: Acolyte
acolyte.desc: Worker. Gathers Soul Essence from soul fonts and builds structures.

skeleton_warrior.name: Skeleton Warrior
skeleton_warrior.desc: Cheap melee fodder. Dies easily, but every death feeds the Abyss.

gravebow_archer.name: Gravebow Archer
gravebow_archer.desc: Ranged skeleton. Fires bone arrows at ground and air.

shadow_adept.name: Shadow Adept
shadow_adept.desc: Cultist caster with a life-drain bolt that heals the adept.

necromancer.name: Necromancer
necromancer.desc: Raises Skeleton Warriors from nearby corpses (auto). Weak in direct combat.

banshee.name: Banshee
banshee.desc: Flying ghost. Fast harasser whose wail strikes ground and air.

flesh_abomination.name: Flesh Abomination
flesh_abomination.desc: Stitched monstrosity. Tanky frontline melee brute.

bone_catapult.name: Bone Catapult
bone_catapult.desc: Siege artillery lobbing putrid skulls. Splash damage, double vs structures.

void_knight.name: Void Knight
void_knight.desc: Elite shock cavalry wreathed in shadow. Fast and armored.

nether_dragon.name: Nether Dragon
nether_dragon.desc: Flying drake exhaling corrupting breath. Splash damage against ground and air.

shade.name: Shade
shade.desc: Minor void shade spawned freely by the Void Gate. Scout and harasser.

deathlord.name: The Deathlord
deathlord.desc: Avatar of Virexus. One may exist. Colossal necrotic titan with a death aura.

tyvaris.name: Warlord Tyvaris
tyvaris.title: the Grave Tyrant
tyvaris.desc: Hulking melee champion. Spreads blight as he walks; undead near him rise once more after death.

neratha.name: Neratha Soulweaver
neratha.title: of the Whisperless Sect
neratha.desc: Frail necromancer crone. Harvests souls, spreads blight and hastens production with blood pacts.

malazar.name: Malazar the Voidcaller
malazar.title: Lich of the Deep Void
malazar.desc: Ranged lich sorcerer. Void bolts, terror veils, portals and the Curse of Undeath.

necropolis.name: Necropolis of Shades
necropolis.desc: Your main base. Trains Acolytes and heroes, drops off souls, spreads blight.

grim_crypt.name: Grim Crypt
grim_crypt.desc: Animates Skeleton Warriors and Gravebow Archers. +8 supply.

occult_den.name: Occult Den
occult_den.desc: Cultist temple. Trains Acolytes and Shadow Adepts, researches dark blessings. +8 supply. Required for Tier 2.

soul_well.name: Soul Well
soul_well.desc: Built on a soul font. Channels 0.8 souls/s from the font automatically and receives what Acolytes mine there. Can sacrifice a friendly unit for a burst of Soul Essence. Spreads blight.

soul_obelisk.name: Soul Obelisk
soul_obelisk.desc: Defensive tower. Necrotic bolts leech life to nearby undead. Longer range on blight.

corruption_spire.name: Corruption Spire
corruption_spire.desc: No attack. Rapidly spreads blight; enemies on blight nearby are slowed and decay.

bone_wall.name: Bone Wall
bone_wall.desc: Wall of fused bone. Regenerates when anything dies beside it.

plague_mine.name: Plague Mine
plague_mine.desc: Invisible trap. Erupts in disease when enemies approach, weakening and sapping them.

necromancer_spire.name: Necromancer's Spire
necromancer_spire.desc: Trains Necromancers and Banshees. Researches Grave March.

flesh_forge.name: Flesh Forge
flesh_forge.desc: Abomination pit. Trains Flesh Abominations and Bone Catapults. Researches Blight Plague.

reliquary.name: Reliquary of Darkness
reliquary.desc: Crafts Dark Relics: vampiric and armor augmentations. Required for Tier 3.

corruption_crucible.name: Corruption Crucible
corruption_crucible.desc: Condenses Soul Essence into Voidstone (3 souls → 2 void per second while active). Spreads blight.

void_gate.name: Void Gate
void_gate.desc: Portal to the Void. Trains Void Knights and Nether Dragons. Periodically spawns free Shades.

cathedral_of_decay.name: Cathedral of Decay
cathedral_of_decay.desc: Ultimate tech. Summons the Deathlord (needs an Oblivion Shard). Researches Death Fog.

blight_plague.name: Blight Plague
blight_plague.desc: Melee attacks inflict disease (damage over time).

death_fog.name: Death Fog
death_fog.desc: All undead gain 10% lifesteal and +1 hp/s regeneration.

tempest.name: Tempest
tempest.blurb: Hit-and-run sky tacticians with a tribute economy. Aetherforges pay Stormsteel automatically, so few workers are needed. Fliers, chain lightning and weather control let you choose every battle — but your units are fragile in a slugfest.
tips: Windcasters only build. Aetherforges on stormglass nodes pay Stormsteel tribute automatically.
Stormcall Arrays on aether vents yield crystals — double during a storm.
Your base can Relocate: lift off and float to a better position.
Alyssia's Cloudburst re-energizes a depleted node. Save a Tempest Pearl for the Eye of Auranth.

tiers.name: Skybreaker Citadel
tiers.desc: Unlocks Tier 2 structures and a second hero. Tempest Barrier aura: allies near base take 25% less ranged damage. More tribute.

tiers.name: Maelstrom Nexus
tiers.desc: Unlocks Tier 3 units and the third hero. Eye of the Storm: during storms your units move faster and take less damage. Base hurls thunderbolts.

windcaster.name: Windcaster
windcaster.desc: Worker. Builds structures. Income comes from tribute, not gathering.

stormblade.name: Stormblade
stormblade.desc: Lightning-charged swordsman. Each hit adds shock damage that ignores armor.

wind_archer.name: Wind Archer
wind_archer.desc: Long-range crossbowman guided by wind spirits. Hits air.

skywing.name: Skywing
skywing.desc: Flying scout with excellent vision. Minimal combat value.

thunderhawk.name: Thunderhawk
thunderhawk.desc: Flying fighter with a stormrifle. Strikes ground and air.

tempest_rider.name: Tempest Rider
tempest_rider.desc: Elite drake cavalry. Devastating dives against ground targets.

storm_golem.name: Storm Golem
storm_golem.desc: Stormsteel construct. Heavy melee bruiser for holding the line.

lightning_cannon.name: Lightning Cannon
lightning_cannon.desc: Siege artillery firing arcing bolts. Splash, double vs structures.

tempest_weaver.name: Tempest Weaver
tempest_weaver.desc: Master sorcerer. Attacks chain lightning to 3 extra targets.

sky_leviathan.name: Sky Leviathan
sky_leviathan.desc: Capital airship: a flying artillery platform bristling with lightning cannons.

armada_trooper.name: Armada Shocktrooper
armada_trooper.desc: Reinforcement summoned by Call of the Armada.

rykan.name: Stormlord Rykan
rykan.title: Sky-Knight of the Council
rykan.desc: Gryphon-riding frontline hero. Thunderstrikes, rallies the winds, and becomes the eye of a storm.

lyrian.name: Skybreaker Lyrian
lyrian.title: Master of Logistics
lyrian.desc: Council engineer. Boosts tribute, shields allies from projectiles, and calls the Armada.

alyssia.name: Stormcaller Alyssia
alyssia.title: Heir of the First Stormcaller
alyssia.desc: Fragile storm mage. Chain lightning, cloudbursts, map-wide clarity and the Hurricane Maelstrom.

stormspire.name: Stormspire Outpost
stormspire.desc: Your floating base. Trains Windcasters and heroes, pays Stormsteel tribute, zaps nearby ground foes. Can relocate.

gale_barracks.name: Gale Barracks
gale_barracks.desc: Trains Stormblades and Wind Archers. Researches Stormsteel Weapons. +8 supply.

aerie.name: Aerie / Skyworks
aerie.desc: Sky-pads for fliers. Trains Skywings; at Tier 2 becomes a Skyworks training Thunderhawks and Tempest Riders. +6 supply.

aetherforge.name: Aetherforge
aetherforge.desc: Built on a stormglass node. Refines ore into Stormsteel tribute automatically (3/s). +6 supply.

stormcall_array.name: Stormcall Array
stormcall_array.desc: Built on an aether vent. Siphons Aether Crystals (1/s, doubled during storms).

stormcall_tower.name: Stormcall Tower
stormcall_tower.desc: Lightning tower (chains to 2) and weather-tech hub. Researches Forecast and Static Shield. Required for Tier 2.

thunderhead_tower.name: Thunderhead Tower
thunderhead_tower.desc: Heavy lightning tower. Prioritizes fliers, chains to 2 targets.

cyclone_totem.name: Cyclone Totem
cyclone_totem.desc: No attack. Allies nearby take 50% less ranged damage; enemies are slowed by the gale.

tempest_barrier.name: Tempest Barrier
tempest_barrier.desc: Wall of solidified wind. Blocks ground AND air movement.

storm_beacon.name: Storm Beacon
storm_beacon.desc: Sensor outpost with enormous vision. Reveals invisible units.

tempest_forge.name: Tempest Forge
tempest_forge.desc: Workshop. Trains Storm Golems and Lightning Cannons. Researches Overcharge Capacitors.

stratosanct.name: Stratosanct
stratosanct.desc: Floating sanctum. Trickles Aether (0.6/s), researches Tribute Efficiency. Required for Tier 3.

stormseer_conclave.name: Stormseer Conclave
stormseer_conclave.desc: Ultimate mage guild. Trains Tempest Weavers. Researches Storm Amplification.

celestial_bastion.name: Celestial Bastion
celestial_bastion.desc: Capital shipyard. Builds Sky Leviathans. +8 supply.

maelstrom_altar.name: Maelstrom Altar
maelstrom_altar.desc: Channels a Tempest Pearl every 150s (holds 1). Spend a Pearl to unleash the Eye of Auranth — a map-wide storm.

forecast.name: Forecast
forecast.desc: Storm and weather abilities last 50% longer.

overcharge.name: Overcharge Capacitors
overcharge.desc: Lightning towers and cannons deal 25% more damage.
